headline: Argentina Sovereign Risk Drops Below 900 Points Amid Bond Rebound
summary: Argentina's country risk index calculated by JP Morgan fell below 900 points as dollar-denominated bonds rebounded following earlier losses.
why: Sovereign risk spreads and dollar bond performance are core indicators of Argentina's external debt sustainability and market confidence.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Falling sovereign risk spreads indicate improved market valuation of government debt instruments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A rebound in sovereign dollar bonds drove a recovery in local asset prices, reducing the JP Morgan country risk indicator below 900 basis points.
